lines: Bram. I keep the station. Kept it for my mother, and she kept it for hers… no. She was the first. Came down in ’87 with everybody.
Section G was built to come down. If the surface came in, you’d close it off and keep the levels below.
Lever under the glass. The map shows it: the gallery’s its own section. Bring it down and the hotel, transit, the homes all stand.
Nobody’s ever pulled it. Nobody needed to.
The gallery’s been quiet a long time. It isn’t now.
Came down from above with the trade. Now they sit on the crossing and take a share of everything going either way.
Lift or chimney, it all ends up on that bridge. Lock the surface door and they’re still on it.
Mara says keep it open: the regulator alone was worth the trouble.
Odi says close it. She’s seen what the crew takes off Wren.
Corvin wants it open. Business. Ellis just wants to know what’s up there.
Me? I keep the station. It’s not my lever to pull.
